props.name: action
props.comment: The action to check (`'list' | 'create' | 'edit' | 'show' | 'delete'` or custom).

props.name: record
props.comment:
Optional record the grant is scoped to (record-level predicates). `id` is
the floor; the rest is whatever the grant's predicate reads, so a record of
the caller's own shape and an inline record both fit.

slots.name: loading
slots.comment: Rendered while the access check is pending. Defaults to nothing.

slots.name: accessDenied
slots.comment: Rendered when access is denied. Defaults to nothing.
